name: Documentation Updater
description: Automatically updates documentation when source files change

action.prompt:
A source file has been modified in this TypeScript/Next.js project. Please review the changes and update the project documentation accordingly. Focus on:

1. If there's a README.md file, update it to reflect any new features, components, or architectural changes
2. If there's a /docs folder, update relevant documentation files there
3. Update any inline code comments or JSDoc if needed
4. Ensure the documentation accurately reflects the current state of the codebase

The project is a LangGraph Playground - a web-based visualization tool for LangGraph workflows with features like real-time code editing, graph visualization, import/export functionality, and theme support.

Please be concise and focus on meaningful changes that would help other developers understand the project structure and functionality.
